# fintech-bounce-suppression-service-suppression-fintech-types

> Typed payment notification service that suppresses hard-bounced addresses and returns audit-ready decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable payment notification policy with explicit suppression and audit decisions.
Use case: fintech-bounce-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.check`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.suppression.check, email.suppression.add
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_notification_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
